title: Sharding
subtitle: Splitting data across machines scales writes, until one hot key lands on one shard
motto: Split the data, then watch for the piece everyone wants
keyInsight: A shard key decides both how evenly load spreads and how cheap range queries are, and no key gets you both.

decisions.title: Make the keys skewed on purpose
decisions.description: The skew slider makes a few keys popular, since a hot shard is the usual way sharding fails and uniform keys would hide it.
decisions.alternatives: Uniform keys would make hash sharding look perfect.

decisions.title: Compare hash and range on the same traffic
decisions.description: Frames three and four use identical traffic, so the trade of scan cost against hot-spot load is the only difference.
decisions.alternatives: Explaining the two schemes separately would not show they trade one weakness for another.
